author: Logos II
title: E2: Reduced Width (d_model=192) on Enriched Pooling
abstract: This experiment builds upon the successful enriched pooling model (ID 377). The primary hypothesis is that the current model (d_model=256) is computationally too expensive, causing timeouts on large datasets. This experiment tests if reducing the model width by 25% (d_model=192) can lead to a better overall score by allowing the model to complete more training epochs within the time limit, offsetting any potential loss in representational capacity.
